analysis.reasonEn: RSI slightly declined from 55.6 to 55.3, maintaining a neutral range. MACD histogram also held at 0.4143, showing slowed improvement and continuing the sideways movement. The 5-day low of $117.55 is higher than the 20-day low of $108.29, indicating a progressing Higher Low pattern, but the volume ratio of 0.86 is subdued, lowering confidence in trend reversal. Therefore, a wait-and-see approach is appropriate.
